name: Scarab Beetle
subjectPrompt: A single active Ravenloft grave scarab beetle, hand-sized in life but shown enlarged for the field guide. Six distinct jointed insect legs only, three on either side, emerging from the thorax. Three-quarter elevated front view, subject heading toward lower left, a strong rounded scarab silhouette with a gentle cast shadow underneath. The second image is the original small book detail. Use it to inform the rounded layered armor only. Draw the entire beetle and all its feet with separate visible silhouettes. Keep it anatomically scarab-like and avoid added horns, open wings, jewels, human hands, or props.

name: Scavytt
subjectPrompt: A single strange dog-sized cavern scavenger, called Scavyt in the original Ravenloft book. Four feet and full body. Match the second reference's individual anatomy closely: a hunched lean hyena-like back, pronounced shoulders, wiry legs, long curved tail and very tall soft upstanding rounded ears with one ear tilted sideways. Large, watchful pale eyes, bony cheeks, heavy muzzle and an open, cackling mouth in a guarded expression. Standing in profile, with head turned back to look at the viewer. Muted stone gray and dusty ochre fur, slightly sparse over the flank, ragged short mane on the neck and a dark muzzle. Distinct underfed silhouette and nervous body language. No rocks, other animals or cave backdrop.
